'''Lucky Runner''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] and a rival of the [[Haven's Blaze]] casino. Haven's Blaze owner [[Otheros]] even put a bounty on Lucky Runner [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncers]].
